sub_sector.value: Automotive steering, driveline, braking and chassis software

manufacturing_type.detail: Manufactures steering and driveline units in-house and integrates hardware, electronics and software into complete systems.

product_complexity.detail: Safety-critical steering and by-wire systems integrate embedded software developed to ASIL D standards and tailored to OEM requirements.

production_role.detail: Full-service supplier to automotive OEMs, providing integrated steering and driveline systems and motion control software.

end_market_exposure.detail: Passenger cars and commercial vehicles through heavy-duty trucks, plus off-road and adjacent mobility applications for MotionIQ software.

notes: It is unclear whether production is scheduled against customer orders or inventory targets.
